name: session
description: Session messaging, retrospective, handoff, transcript export, session search, reorientation, destination-fork guidance, and Session Toolkit CLI workflows for coding-agent conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve, search, review, and continue sessions; use the Session Toolkit CLI.
interface.longDescription: Session skills for reviewing bounded episodes, transferring coding context, exporting sanitized conversations, finding past sessions across local Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor stores, rebuilding the arc of a long or compacted thread, and preparing read-only destination-tab fork instructions. Session Toolkit CLI guidance covers capability checks, identity, discovery, search, bounded reads, Markdown export, activity, and Codex evidence through the separately installed seshtk executable.
defaultPrompt: Use Session Retro to review a bounded episode, Session Export Transcript to save a sanitized conversation, Session Search to find a past session, Reorient to rebuild a long thread, or Session Fork to Destination to prepare destination-tab instructions. Use seshtk-cli for Session Toolkit command workflows and troubleshooting.

permission_verification: Static packaging and isolated export execution are verified; live provider discovery and permission behavior remain unverified.
